question: Will the 10-year Treasury yield close at or above 5.25% on 31 December 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if FRED series DGS10 for 2026-12-31 is >= 5.25. If 2026-12-31 has no observation, use the last observation before it.

reasoning.outside_view: From 5.15%, a driftless random walk over about 32 trading days at 5.49bp/day (sd 31bp) gives 0.37 for ending at or above 5.25%.
reasoning.decomposition: Needs a net rise of at least 10bp by year end, through a December FOMC meeting and year-end positioning.
reasoning.inside_view: Hiking cycle and recent upward momentum argue slightly above the random walk; the September 2026 high was 5.29%, so 5.25% is near the top of the recent range, where yields have stalled before.
reasoning.what_would_change_my_mind: A hawkish December FOMC (another hike plus guidance) moves this toward 0.55; a growth scare or a dovish surprise toward 0.2.
